The '''55th [[Writers Guild of America Award]]s''', given in 2003, honored the [[film]] and [[television]] best writers of 2002.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://awards.wga.org/awards/nominees-winners/2005-1996 |title=Writers Guild Awards Winners: 2005-1996 |work=wga.org |publisher=Writers Guild of America |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260217142826/https://awards.wga.org/awards/nominees-winners/2005-1996 |archive-date=2026-02-17 |access-date=2026-02-20 |url-status=live }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.imdb.com/event/ev0000710/2003/1/|title=Writers Guild of America, USA (2003)|website=IMDb|access-date=2026-02-20}}</ref>


==Film==
===Best Original Screenplay===
''' ''[[Bowling for Columbine]]'' - [[Michael Moore]]'''
*''[[Antwone Fisher (film)|Antwone Fisher]]'' - [[Antwone Fisher]]
*''[[Far from Heaven]]'' - [[Todd Haynes]]
*''[[Gangs of New York]]'' - [[Jay Cocks]], [[Kenneth Lonergan]] and [[Steven Zaillian]] 
*''[[My Big Fat Greek Wedding]]'' - [[Nia Vardalos]]

===Best Adapted Screenplay===
''' ''[[The Hours (film)|The Hours]]'' - [[David Hare (dramatist)|David Hare]]'''
*''[[About a Boy (film)|About a Boy]]'' - [[Peter Hedges]], [[Chris Weitz|Chris]] and [[Paul Weitz (filmmaker)|Paul Weitz]]
*''[[About Schmidt]]'' - [[Alexander Payne]] and [[Jim Taylor (writer)|Jim Taylor]]
*''[[Adaptation (film)|Adaptation.]]'' - [[Charlie Kaufman|Charlie]] and Donald Kaufman
*''[[Chicago (2002 film)|Chicago]]'' - [[Bill Condon]]

==Television==
===Best Episodic Comedy===
''' ''[[Frasier]]'' - [[Bob Daily]], [[Lori Kirkland]] and [[Dan O'Shannon]] for "Rooms With a View"'''
*''[[The Bernie Mac Show]]'' - [[Larry Wilmore]] for "Pilot"
*''[[Ed (TV series)|Ed]]'' - [[Jon Beckerman]] and [[Rob Burnett (producer)|Rob Burnett]] for "The Wedding"
*''[[Scrubs (2001 TV series)|Scrubs]]'' - [[Bill Lawrence (producer)|Bill Lawrence]] for "My First Day (Pilot)"
*''[[Sex and the City]]'' - [[Cindy Chupack]] for "Plus One Is the Loneliest Number"
*''[[Sex and the City]]'' - [[Michael Patrick King]] for "I Heart NY"
*''[[Sex and the City]]'' - [[Julie Rottenberg; Elisa Zuritsky]] for "Change of a Dress"

===Best Episodic Drama===
''' ''[[The Education of Max Bickford]]'' - [[Dawn Prestwich]] and [[Nicole Yorkin]] for "Pilot"'''
*''[[ER (TV series)|ER]]'' - [[John Wells (TV producer)|John Wells]] for "On the Beach"
*''[[Resurrection Blvd.]]'' - [[Robert Eisele]] for "Nino Del Polvo"
*''[[Six Feet Under (TV series)|Six Feet Under]]'' - [[Christian Taylor (screenwriter)|Christian Taylor]] for "In Place of Anger"
*''[[The Sopranos]]'' - [[Mitchell Burgess]] and [[Robin Green]] for "Whoever Did This"
*''[[The West Wing]]'' - [[Paul Redford]] and [[Aaron Sorkin]] for "Game On"
